snippet.title: Presto! - Gameplay Demo - New N64-Style 3D Collectathon Platformer
snippet.description:
Jump into an N64-style 3D collectathon! Explore surreal worlds as Presto with classic platforming action and a physics-based Rolling Globe for bouncing and rolling around! Collect Stars and Memory Cores to restore the magic of the past, with optional rankings for skilled players.

Playtest 'Presto!' now on Steam: (https://store.steampowered.com/app/4312200/Presto/?beta=0)

Press Kit: https://impress.games/press-kit/circus-cat-studios/presto

Join our Discord Server: (https://discord.gg/gh6fumYvSR)
